1.w: By David. O Lord, I come before you in prayer.

2.w: My God, I trust in you. Please do not let me be humiliated; do not let my enemies triumphantly rejoice over me.

3.w: Certainly none who rely on you will be humiliated. Those who deal in treachery will be thwarted and humiliated.

4.w: Make me understand your ways, O Lord. Teach me your paths.

5.w: Guide me into your truth and teach me. For you are the God who delivers me; on you I rely all day long.

6.w: Remember your compassionate and faithful deeds, O Lord, for you have always acted in this manner.

7.w: Do not hold against me the sins of my youth or my rebellious acts. Because you are faithful to me, extend to me your favor, O Lord.

8.w: The Lord is both kind and fair; that is why he teaches sinners the right way to live.

9.w: May he show the humble what is right. May he teach the humble his way.

10.w: The Lord always proves faithful and reliable to those who follow the demands of his covenant.

11.w: For the sake of your reputation, O Lord, forgive my sin, because it is great.

12.w: The Lord shows his faithful followers the way they should live.

13.w: They experience his favor; their descendants inherit the land.

14.w: The Lord’s loyal followers receive his guidance, and he reveals his covenantal demands to them.

15.w: I continually look to the Lord for help, for he will free my feet from the enemy’s net.

16.w: Turn toward me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and oppressed.

17.w: Deliver me from my distress; rescue me from my suffering.

18.w: See my pain and suffering. Forgive all my sins.

19.w: Watch my enemies, for they outnumber me; they hate me and want to harm me.

20.w: Protect me and deliver me! Please do not let me be humiliated, for I have taken shelter in you.

21.w: May integrity and godliness protect me, for I rely on you.

22.w: O God, rescue Israel from all their distress!
